audit.why: Renekton favoured at 55.96% over 1662 games. Mel is ranged with zero mobility, so level 1 is her only free window and every stage after level 2 belongs to Renekton's E-W-Q pattern.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays FAV/7.5-10; lane is decided at level 2 when Slice and Dice comes online.
sources: kit: Mel has no dash in any slot

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row gave the stage to Mel in both layers while whys[4] and spikes[1].text describe level 6 as Renekton's kill window.
audit.why: Dominus grants bonus health and periodic Fury; the HP buffer pushes Renekton out of Overwhelm execute range and the Fury enables back-to-back 1.5s empowered stuns. Mel's Golden Eclipse is a global damage ult, not a lane-fight answer.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flips to Renekton in both layers, rating 3/10 -> 6/10, and the why now names Dominus and the execute threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal (W) was described only as a reflect that 'does nothing' — its damage-prevention half was never stated, and its cooldown never appeared.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rebuttal reflects enemy projectiles, prevents her from taking damage, and grants movement speed, on 38/35/33/29/26s. That blanks a full Renekton burst if you commit into it, which is exactly the missingInteraction flagged for this matchup (shield-absorbs-burst).
audit.corrected: State that Rebuttal blanks your burst damage for its duration and is 38s at rank 1 — force or wait it out before committing. Solar Snare's 11s rank-1 cooldown is now given as a number in the do's.
sources: kit: Mel W Rebuttal text + cd
kit: Mel E Solar Snare cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9

audit.why: Solar Snare at 11s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown and the text already keys engages to it; adding the number makes it actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel's passive gives bonus projectiles on her next attack after any ability cast — the auto-attack wind-up is the burst tell, not the ability.
audit.why: Searing Brilliance carries the autoReset flag and the missingInteractions file flags autoreset-burst-tell for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Not written into prose this pass to stay inside the length band; recorded here and in notes.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus health and Fury generation give back-to-back empowered W-stuns, and the buffer keeps you above her Overwhelm execute range.

edits.before: E online: gap-close through her Q volley, land empowered W-stun (point-and-click — her W Rebuttal cannot reflect it), Q heals the poke back.
edits.after: E online: gap-close through her Radiant Volley, land empowered W-stun, Q heals the poke back — but Rebuttal blanks your damage while it is up.

edits.before: Hold W Rebuttal for your empowered W-stun window so the reflect timing punishes your commit
edits.after: Hold Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) for your commit so it blanks the damage of your whole burst

edits.before: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Solar Snare roots at its centre, 11s cooldown at rank 1 — bait it, then engage inside that window.
